quest.title: Across the Wilderness
quest.description: In Mondstadt, an adventurer seems to be recruiting people...

dialogues.speaker: Vinkel
dialogues.text: Good day, fellow adventurers! Anyone who's interested in the new event held by the Adventurers' Guild, please gather around!

dialogues.speaker: Vinkel
dialogues.text: So long as you participate in the event, you will receive not only rewards offered by the Adventurers' Guild, but also certain extra special gifts!

choices.text: The Adventurers' Guild is holding an event?

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: You are... the Traveler! Oh my, what a pleasant surprise. I wasn't expecting to see you at all!

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: As you can see, I'm recruiting participants for an event held by the Guild.

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: This is my first official job in the Guild, and I'm determined to leave a perfect impression!

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: Ah, you must've not heard about the event!

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: Jack has named the event "Across the Wilderness."

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: In his words, this event is gonna be "simple yet fun, and at the same time can test the capabilities of the participating adventurers."

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: To be more specific, we are going to set up Wilderness Balloons in various locations.

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: All that the participating adventurers need to do is to find the Wilderness Balloons according to the prompts and venture forward following the distribution of those balloons.

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: The more Wilderness Balloons one collects within the time limit, the higher the rating and the greater the rewards will be.

choices.text: What if I accidentally popped the balloons...

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: These balloons are no ordinary balloons. They can withstand arrows from afar and will only be popped from close range.

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: When similar events were held before, the first thing most adventurers did when they saw the balloons was to pop them with their arrows. We repeatedly told them not to, but they never listened...

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: That's why we've customized these special balloons for this event. Hopefully it works...

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: And please excuse me but I've gotta go now. I still need to recruit quite a few participants for the event...

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: If you are interested, please do come and participate! If you are willing to take part, I'm sure Jack and Master Cyrus will be thrilled!

choices.text: That sounds like just a long-distance race to me...

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: "Searching for the balloons is a test of the adventurers' observation skills, while venturing forward in different situations is a test of their fundamentals..."

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: "And whether they can act according to the prompts is a test of their discipline..."

response.speaker: Vinkel
response.text: I just joined the Guild, and I don't know much about these things... But since Jack said so, there must be a reason.
